mappings.note: Which type of noun 'sona' is -- sangya bhed, the written language-system LO; not C-HIN2.1-LO-2, no word meaning is asked.
Which person 'main' is -- purush of the pronoun, a grammatical category.
Meaning of the idiom 'taalu mein jeebh na lagna' -- the muhavra LO; C-HIN4.1-LO-1 covers grammatical form, and an idiom's sense is not a form.
Meaning of 'than than gopal' -- idiom sense.
Meaning of 'khoon paani hona' -- idiom sense.
Meaning of 'udti chidiyon ke pankh ginna' -- idiom sense.
Meaning of the lokokti 'maange bheekh pooche gaanv ki jama' -- the LO names lokoktiyan explicitly.
Meaning of 'koi ir ghaat to koi beer ghaat' -- lokokti sense.
Meaning of 'hansue ke byaah mein khurpi ka geet' -- lokokti sense.
Which lokokti fits 'much show, no substance' -- the reverse direction of the same lokokti LO.
Completing the lokokti 'chor-chor ... bhai' -- recall of a proverb's wording, still the lokokti LO and not a writing outcome.
Meaning of 'puchkaara kutta sir chadhe' -- lokokti sense.
Meaning of 'kumhaar apna hi ghada saraahta hai' -- lokokti sense; note the potter here is proverbial, not the chapter's craft, so not C-HIN3.2-LO-1.
Meaning of 'gaye the roza chhudaane, namaz gale padi' -- lokokti sense.
